scope:
Conditional developer free-arc model comparison; not a production/raw API.

The generator is a conditional-area integral. The finite comparator reuses the
separate research lineage's private radial-flux kernel at continuous rectified
points, H=I, and rectified covariance. No integer pixels or source samples are
invented. All local fit outcomes and material-mismatch controls are retained.

provenance.forward_origin: backend/finite_shape.py in separate finite-shape research lineage at c9daa2a
provenance.vendor_change: Only relative fitting import changed to backend.fitting.arc_geometry.
provenance.initial_ignored_rotation_failure: Q Sigma Q^T float asymmetry of one ULP violated the old kernel's exact symmetry contract. Initial result is retained locally; the portable adapter records and symmetrizes only arithmetic-scale rotation asymmetry, without changing cases or recovery criteria.

limitations: The finite comparator assumes a whole disk, known stationary rectified Gaussian covariance and true half-level; a circular boundary span alone does not establish the material hypothesis.
Continuous rectified queries use a private study kernel with identity homography. No integer-pixel raw-source API or measured raw optical PSF is invoked.
Only stored centre/radius are compared. No closed-ring join, emitted CAD, image segmentation or physical geometry is accepted.
Local bounded iterations retain stopping reasons and do not certify all minima, global identification or uncertainty.
Probability divided by spatial gradient is a first-order normal residual diagnostic, not an exact closest-boundary distance.
Quadrature-order and derivative agreement are numerical controls, not certified enclosures.

plan.scope: Read-only conditional local fits of unknown disk centre/radius from exact-level points. Known stationary Gaussian covariance and normalized threshold are supplied. No production repair, global identifiability, camera or physical claim.
plan.generator: Frozen curve-blur-frames-v1 conditional area oracle, GL32/64 and 44 bisections.

settings.search: centre in observed-fit centre +-Rtruth, radius [.1Rtruth,3Rtruth], fixed before execution

plan.policy: Retain all rows and negative outcomes. Only finite-disk matched rows carry the predeclared recovery criterion; asymptotic comparators have no required improvement. Source mismatch and point perturbations have no recovery assertion. Local fits do not choose joins or justify a whole disk from a free arc.
